body.para: A rare being from the forests of New England, transplanted to California.

Most of &_;my work&_; has been in programming language technology, including type systems, modern compiler design, parsing, code generation, usability design, and garbage collector implementation. I am familiar with an unusually broad array of programming technologies, but I have the most familiarity and professional experience with Haskell, C, C++, Rust, and Perl.

val.para: Gathered writings on crochet and other yarncraft.
